edits.before: Echo economy: bank the third cast for the moment that matters.
edits.after: Repeated Twisted Advance roots outpace your mana-hungry poke through levels 4-5.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Beat Drop banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): 10-14s cooldown — point-and-click root, count it before stepping up. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep E Beat Drop (9-11s CD) banked for his best play. - The 90-130s ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: He's untargetable mid-dash on Twisted Advance — don't dump burst into the animation. Count the 10-14s cooldown before stepping up.

edits.before: Echoed Q the pair, W the trade-back, E the disengage — taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Sap Magic heals him off autos and shortens its own cooldown on spell contact — time Grievous Wounds before you commit to a long trade.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W off-rhythm — the third note is the champion.
edits.after: His flash window off Twisted Advance is when the root lands — trading evenly into it just feeds his all-in.
